[Problem]{.card-kicker} **3Sum Closest** [LC 16 · 3Sum Closest](https://leetcode.com/problems/3sum-closest/){difficulty="Medium"}

Same skeleton as 3Sum (@sec-tp-p2-a) — sort, fix $a[i]$, squeeze the tail — but the squeeze no longer hunts an exact target; it tracks the **best distance seen**. Because the tail is sorted, moving $\mathit{lo}$ up raises the sum and $\mathit{hi}$ down lowers it, so the sum sweeps monotonically toward $\mathit{target}$ and every visited triple is a candidate on the way. The one difference that bites: closeness is $|s - \mathit{target}|$, and two sums on opposite sides can be *equidistant* — compare distances, never the raw sums.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p2-b.]{.card-link}

:::
